rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something emits heat, light, rays, or waves.

example.english: This lamp can radiate a soft light.
example.jyutping: ne1 zaan2 dang1 faat3 ceot1 jau4 wo4 ge3 gwong1

rows.note: Use this when a person or their face seems to emanate a strong positive feeling or quality.

example.traditional: 佢成日散發出一種令人安心嘅氣場。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 saan3 faat3 ceot1 jat1 zung2 ling6 jan4 on1 sam1 ge3 hei3 coeng4

rows.jyutping: jau4 A hoeng3 ngoi6 san1 zin2
rows.note: Use this for roads, routes, or other things extending outward from a central point.

example.english: The new road is designed to radiate outward from the city centre, connecting several housing estates.
example.traditional: 條新路由市中心向外伸展，接通幾個屋苑。
example.jyutping: tiu4 san1 lou6 jau4 si5 zung1 sam1 hoeng3 ngoi6 san1 zin2 zip3 tung1 gei2 go3 uk1 jyun2
